documentary_notes.location: Note 1, Software Development Costs and Internal-Use Software Development Costs
documentary_notes.fact: No product software development costs capitalized in FY2024-FY2026. Qualifying internal-use software costs capitalized to PP&E; separate annual additions not disclosed. Computer software gross PP&E: $66m FY2026, $329m FY2025. Gross stock movement is not investment cash flow. All capex retained; no second software deduction.
Tax R&D capitalization is distinct from GAAP capitalization. OBBB permits current R&D tax expensing from FY2026; GAAP ordinary R&D remains expensed.
Final transition-tax payment $179m in Q2FY2026. Retained in reported CFO/FCF; isolated optional sensitivity, not recurring cash earning.

documentary_notes.location: Note 6, Gains/losses on sale or derecognition of assets
documentary_notes.fact: Spot business sold to Flexera, closed March 3 2025. $70m upfront cash, contingent consideration up to $49m; initially recognized $20m contingent asset. No material initial gain/loss. FY2025 includes sold business until disposition; no complete recast organic revenue supplied.

documentary_notes.location: Note 6, Gains/losses on sale or derecognition of assets
documentary_notes.fact: FY2026 recognized additional $11m contingent consideration and corresponding gain; cash expected FY2027. FY2026 release reconciliation nets this against $1m other asset loss: net adjustment -$10m. Retain separate gross and net amounts.

Acquired DataPelago July16 2026. $193m purchase price: $87m cash at closing, $106m contingent consideration; $9m cash acquired and $78m net cash outflow. $22m acquired developed technology, $151m goodwill. Acquisition cash is outside reported FCF and shown separately; recurring technology amortization retained.
Restructuring recurs FY2024/FY2025/FY2026 ($44m/$83m/$21m) and Q1FY2027 $56m. All charges and cash costs retained in conservative metrics. Q1FY2027 plan expected substantially complete by FY2027 end.

documentary_notes.location: Note 1, Basis of Presentation and Preparation
documentary_notes.fact: Q1FY2027 has 14 weeks; Q1FY2026 and all FY2024-FY2026 quarters 13 weeks. Current TTM has 53 weeks versus 52 prior. No exact earnings or cash equal-week normalization claimed.

documentary_notes.location: MD&A, Cash Flows from Operating Activities
documentary_notes.fact: Q1FY2027 cash inventory increase $176m versus $54m source in prior Q1; strategic component and finished-goods purchases. Receivables cash source $317m vs $466m prior. All working capital retained; no automatic add-back.

Management estimates additional week revenue approximately $65m, including support $50m and Public Cloud $15m; non-GAAP operating expenses approximately $22m. Management states revenue growth 26% excluding extra week. These rounded estimates do not identify exact GAAP profit or CFO effects; no exact GAAP equal-week normalization.

FY2026 cash-flow D&A $200m comprises PP&E depreciation/amortization $179m and acquired-intangible amortization $21m. Do not add intangible amortization twice. TTM total D&A $182m; separate acquired-intangible $21m and PP&E $161m.

FY2025 effective tax rate 14.2%, FY2026 22.6%. Release separately identifies tax-matter-resolution benefit $39m FY2025 and $5m FY2026; $36m FY2025 IRS reserve release described in 10-K is a subset, not the full reconciliation row. Core net income remains GAAP; no forecast tax rate is inferred from FY2025.

Public Cloud cost of revenue includes depreciation/amortization and third-party datacenter fees. These costs stay in GAAP earnings. No separate cash cloud-investment/capex additions series disclosed; retain consolidated cash PP&E capex.

conflicts.basis: Latest SEC-filed comparison; prior values retained in private companyfacts archive.
conflicts.resolution: Resolved by reading filing tables: H1FY2025 cash taxes $222m in original Q2FY2025 and comparative Q2FY2026. $287m in Q3FY2025 is explicitly NINE months ended Jan24 2025; companyfacts start/end context mislabels it as H1. Use222 for H1,287 for9M; do not treat as economic restatement.
